subject: Negative chi-square and df in EFA with PML-AC estimation

messages.author: 671d6eab1c9655cc
messages.subject: Negative chi-square and df in EFA with PML-AC estimation
parts:
Hi, everyone,

I ran EFAs for 36 ordinal items (each on a 4-point Likert scale) with 2-6 factors using pairwise maximum likelihood estimation ("PML") on available cases ("available.cases").

efa(nfactors = 2:6, rotation = "oblimin", ordered = TRUE, estimator = "PML", missing = "available.cases")

It seems odd in the summary that except for the case of 3 factors, the chi-square and degrees of freedom are negative. Any idea what might be going on?


The full summary output is attached. I would very much appreciate any input!

Jeremy
